title: Curvature-Calibrated Quasi-Bayesian Updating for Moment-Restricted Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.19634v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Moment restrictions provide a flexible basis for quasi-Bayesian inference when a full likelihood is unavailable, but the weighting matrix in a quadratic moment criterion determines both the relative importance of the moments and the information scale of posterior updating. We propose curvature-calibrated quasi-Bayesian updating, which uses the inverse of the covariance (or long-run covariance) of the moment conditions evaluated at a self-consistent quasi-posterior center. The resulting fixed-point procedure alternates between covariance estimation and simulation from a fixed-weight quasi-posterior, thereby avoiding parameter-dependent weighting during each simulation run. translated_title: 曲率校准的拟贝叶斯更新用于矩约束模型
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.19634v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：矩约束为无法获得完整似然时的拟贝叶斯推断提供了灵活基础，但二次矩准则中的权重矩阵决定了矩的相对重要性和后验更新的信息尺度。我们提出了曲率校准的拟贝叶斯更新方法，该方法使用在自洽拟后验中心处评估的矩条件协方差（或长期协方差）的逆作为权重。由此产生的定点过程在协方差估计和从固定权重拟后验中进行模拟之间交替进行，从而避免了每次模拟运行中参数依赖的权重。在固定权重拟后验在有效总体权重下满足伯恩斯坦-冯·米塞斯条件的假设下，我们证明了校准映射局部收缩，其定点以标准参数速率保持一致，并且高斯近似...
tldr: 该方法通过迭代校准权重矩阵，实现矩约束模型的拟贝叶斯后验更新，保证一致性和收缩性。
en_tdlr: This method iteratively calibrates the weighting matrix for quasi-Bayesian updating in moment-restricted models, ensuring consistency and contractive behavior.
